## Dipl. Pflegefachfrau Pflegefachmann FH Wald – Pflege ist mehr als nur ein Beruf
Du arbeitest als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau oder Pflegefachmann FH Wald, und du spürst jeden Tag, dass Pflege mehr ist als ein Job. Als Dipl Pflegefachfrau Pflegefachmann FH Wald setzt du dich für das Wohl der Menschen ein. Du hilfst Menschen in wichtigen Momenten, und gleichzeitig gibst du Sicherheit, sodass Vertrauen entsteht und Hoffnung wächst.
Wald liegt in der östlichen Schweiz im Kanton Zürich und besticht durch seine günstige Lage zwischen Zürich und St. Gallen. Sie erreichen den Ort problemlos über die Bahnlinie und das gut ausgebaute Strassennetz. Die Region bietet Ihnen eine attraktive Balance zwischen wirtschaftlicher Dynamik, lebenswertem Umfeld und guter Infrastruktur, was sie zum idealen Arbeitsort macht.
Du begleitest Patientinnen und Patienten durch schwierige Zeiten, und du bist oft die Person, die Halt gibt. Genau deshalb ist Pflege nicht nur Arbeit, sondern auch eine echte Berufung, die Verantwortung und Menschlichkeit verbindet.

s.h: Aiglon College seeks to appoint a suitably qualified
s.t:
School Nurse
to join the school from: 02.11.2026
Your profile
The role and candidate profile for this role is detailed in the attached job description and person specification.
Successful Aiglon staff are enthusiastic, experienced, committed, reflective, dynamic and willing to try new ideas. If you share these values and have an appetite for challenge and an ambition to make a positive impact on our world, we welcome your application.

Located in Chesières (Vaud, Switzerland), Aiglon College is a not-for-profit, international boarding school offering a distinctive, world-class education in a stunning alpine setting.
The school was founded on a distinctive ethos: the balanced development of mind, body and spirit. This philosophy underpins everything we do at Aiglon, both inside and outside the classroom.
There are over 480 students, representing more than 70 nationalities, following the International GCSE (IGCSE) and International Baccalaureate Diploma (IB Diploma) programmes.

Aiglon is dedicated to the well-being and professional development of all staff, within a vibrant, friendly, and modern workplace. Beyond competitive salaries and comprehensive social security benefits, we provide free accident and loss of salary insurances, generous pension and leave entitlements, as well as a range of special perks and advantages.

Deadline for applications: 18.09.2026
Early applications are encouraged. We reserve the right to appoint before the application deadline should we find the right candidate. Please apply through our School platform (eteach) following the instructions; applications sent by standard email will not be considered.
Aiglon is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children.
Applicants will therefore need to undergo child protection screening appropriate to the post.
You can find information on how the School processes your personal data within the School’s Privacy Notice.
Job title: School Nurse
Reporting to: Associate Director of Nursing & Associate Director of Health Care Services

To provide high-quality, evidence-based nursing care to students, staff, and visitors in accordance with Swiss nursing standards, Croix-Rouge protocols, and NMC guidance (if applicable).
The School Nurse promotes the physical, emotional, and mental wellbeing of all students and ensures that safeguarding and child protection principles are embedded in all aspects of practice.
This role organisationally relates to: the School Director, Deputy School Directors, Bursar (Chief Finance and Operations Officer), House staff, Teaching staff, Sports and Expeditions departments.

Professional Conduct
Adhere to Swiss nursing regulations, the NMC Code of Professional Conduct (if applicable), and relevant advisory papers.
Deliver evidence-based nursing care in accordance with Swiss standards and Croix-Rouge protocols.
Maintain confidentiality at all times, following Swiss data protection (DSG/FADP) and child protection legislation.
Uphold and actively promote the school’s Safeguarding and Child Protection Policy, reporting any concerns immediately to the Designated Safeguarding Lead (DSL).
Participate in ongoing professional development and safeguarding training.
Nursing Care
Provide high-standard nursing services to students, staff, and visitors.
Organise and run nurse clinics during duty hours.
Assess injuries, illnesses, and health conditions, create care plans, and refer to secondary care when appropriate.
Administer medications in accordance with prescriptions, care plans, and Swiss legal requirements.
Develop and maintain individual care plans in collaboration with house staff, wellbeing coordinators, and parents.
Apply Gillick competence when assessing students’ capacity to consent to treatment.
Communicate with parents in cases of significant injury, illness, or emergencies while maintaining medical confidentiality.
Deliver first aid and emergency care according to Croix-Rouge standards; maintain and restock first aid kits.
Provide confidential counselling and health advice when appropriate.
Administer vaccinations and follow infectious disease control procedures in compliance with FOPH (Federal Office of Public Health) guidelines.
Safely manage and store medical supplies, clinical waste, and medications according to Swiss regulations.
Record all appointments and interventions accurately in the real-time database.
Supervise care of unwell students during the night in the health centre, in houses and coordinate with house staff.
Remain vigilant to signs of abuse or neglect, record concerns accurately, and report them immediately to the DSL.

Promote health education across the school following Croix-Rouge and Swiss health promotion standards.
Support wellbeing and pastoral initiatives in collaboration with teaching and pastoral teams.
Keep up to date with current health promotion and safeguarding programmes.
Participate in Atelier Clinic or similar forums to discuss relevant health and wellbeing topics.
Administration
Maintain accurate, confidential medical records.
Record all medication dispensing according to protocol.
Manage general Health Centre administrative duties and ensure efficient daily operations.
Complete medico-legal accident and incident reports for insurance claims.
Assist with ordering, accounting, and distribution of medical supplies.
Maintain health budgets and expenditure records.
Health & Safety
Maintain awareness of health and safety issues affecting staff, students, and the school environment, following Swiss workplace safety standards.
Contribute to health-related risk assessments for trips, events, and activities.
Ensure all health and safety protocols are followed within the Health Centre.
Liaison and Collaboration
Work closely with the Health Centre team, house staff, pastoral care, academic staff, and parents.
Liaise with external medical professionals, including doctors, hospitals, and therapists, for treatment coordination and follow-up.
Maintain confidentiality in all communications and documentation.
Participate in multidisciplinary meetings concerning student welfare and safeguarding.
Safeguarding and Child Protection
Promote a culture of vigilance and care, ensuring safeguarding is central to all nursing and pastoral practices.
Understand and implement the school’s Safeguarding and Child Protections Policy.
Attend regular safeguarding and child protection training as required.
Maintain professional boundaries and appropriate relationships with students.
Act promptly and appropriately if concerned about a student’s welfare, ensuring all concerns are accurately recorded and reported.
Support the DSL in promoting safeguarding awareness across the school community.
Hours of Work
Term-time only.
Includes night duty, on-call, weekends, and unsocial hours.
Expected to work the week before term starts to prepare the Health Centre.
Opportunity to support Aiglon’s Summer Camp.

Understand and implement all school policies and procedures, particular those relating to safeguarding children and young people.
Undertake any other task which may be reasonably requested by the Associate Director of Nursing and the Associate Director of Health Care Services to assist in the smooth running of the team.

Develop plans to address patient’s comprehensive needs including education, safety, comfort and spirituality.
Coordinate and initiate internal and external referral and the multidisciplinary care of research patients.
Plan and evaluate care including establishing policies, guidelines and priorities.
In collaboration with supervisor, research and resolve uncommon situations in patient care that require creativity and innovation.

Assess complex and sensitive health education needs in individual patient populations with like conditions, protocols or other characteristics.
In order to meet the Basic Qualification Requirements for a Nurse (Clinical Research), GS-0610, you must have: A. a graduate or higher level degree, bachelor's degree, associate degree, or diploma from an accredited professional nursing educational program.

Note: Official certification from the Commission on Graduates of Foreign Nursing Schools is required for individuals who graduated from foreign nursing schools; AND B. passed the National Council Licensure Examination for Registered Nurses (NCLEX-RN); AND C. possess a current, active, full and unrestricted license, or registration as a professional nurse from a state, the District of Columbia, the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico, or a territory of the United States.

In addition, in order to qualify for a Clinical Nurse position at the GS-11 level, you must have: A. completed a Ph.D., or equivalent doctoral degree, from a professional nursing educational program or related medical science field; OR B. at least 1 year of professional nursing experience equivalent to at least the GS-09 level in the federal service obtained in either the private or public sector, performing the following types of tasks:1.) Providing comprehensive nursing care to patients based on the physician's medical care plan and the physical, mental and emotional needs of the patient 2.) Administering oxygen, IV fluid, blood transfusions and prescribed oral, subcutaneous and intramuscular medications. 3.) Managing nasal-pharyngeal and gastric suction as well as a variety of other drainage tubes; preparing patients for surgical and/or diagnostic procedures. 4.) Setting-up, operating and monitoring specialized equipment such as cardiac monitors, respirators, defibrillators, etc.

* *Klinische Einschätzung*: Du beobachtest den klinischen Zustand deiner Patient:innen aufmerksam, reagierst bei Veränderungen situationsgerecht und leitest entsprechende Massnahmen ein
* *Patientenedukation*: Du informierst und berätst Patient:innen verständlich über den Eingriff, die Nachsorge und das Verhalten nach dem Spitalaustritt und stellst eine sichere Übergabe in die weitere Versorgung sicher
* *Interprofessionelle Zusammenarbeit*: Du arbeitest eng mit dem ärztlichen Team, dem interventionellen Bereich und weiteren beteiligten Berufsgruppen zusammen

**Contrat fixe à durée indeterminée**

* Effectuer les évaluations et réévaluations de l'ensemble des situations des clients à leur domicile, à l'aide de la méthode RAI\-HC (Resident Assessment Instrument \- Home Care)

* Planifier, coordonner et dispenser des soins et en assurer le suivi
* Conseiller et informer les personnes soignées et leur entourage
* Contribuer au maintien de la santé et à la prévention de la maladie par une approche interdisciplinaire

Nous offrons
* Un environnement de travail qui privilègie le contact humain et l'échange
* Une activité stimulante et enrichissante au sein d'une équipe pluridisciplinaire dynamique
* Des offres de formations riches et variées
* Des conditions de travail et de rémunération selon la Convention Collective de Travail (CCT) dans le secteur sanitaire parapublic vaudois
Les avantages de nous rejoindre
* Plan d’intégration par métier, offres de formations continues riches et variées, possibilités d’évolution professionnelle
* L'équité salariale entre femmes et hommes (certification Fair\-ON\-Pay)
* Rémunération selon la Convention Collective de Travail (CCT) du secteur sanitaire parapublic vaudois
